data.description: RED task. Update every AcliClient mutation call in plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/applier.py with 30s per-call timeout. Retryable failures (timeout, 5xx, 429): retry with exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s). Non-retryable (4xx except 429, auth): fail fast. On Jira retry exhaustion, raise existing applier error type so top-level handler emits kind='abort_due_to_error'. Backoff is inside Jira-call boundary, orthogonal to rebase_retry. Unit tests: hung call interrupted at 30s, 503 retries with backoff, 401 fails fast.
data.title: Apply 30s timeout and exponential backoff to AcliClient Jira calls in applier.py
